original_test_intent: Execute the approved comprehensive DCGM diagnostic scope and determine the result of every included software and hardware subtest against a protected whole-GPU baseline.
original_method: Pin GPU/driver/firmware/DCGM and internal script; baseline enumeration, memory/ECC/XID/retirement, PCIe/AER, thermals, power and services; resolve source level 4 versus DeepSeek level 5 and included subtests; drain workloads, preserve logs, establish approved runtime state, run once with continuous monitoring, compare all health state and recover services/devices.
manual_activity: GPU validation owner chooses level and full subtest manifest, approves workload interruption and hardware-impact limits; operator provides OOB recovery and continuous thermal/power/error monitoring.
required_inputs: Level 4 versus level 5 documentation and complete subtest manifest
OOB, cooling/power/error stop limits and recovery
safety_requirements: Do not run both diagnostic levels by assumption
Preserve all health counters and complete output
Drain workloads before broad hardware tests
Hard-stop on anomaly and never auto-retry
agent_execution_scope: Verify variant identity, scope, baseline and approval
Map every software/hardware subtest and health delta
Restore final state and report without DUT verdict
